runtime_package_differences.effect: Only compiler backends for LoongArch and MIPS are modified; neither patch touches libgcc/libstdc++/libgomp or x86 compiler paths. Both patches retained in source payload.

provenance.description: Configuration-origin revision identified by the pinned BtbN config. CT_LoadConfig imports CT_VERSION from that config, so compiler version strings do not authenticate the floating builder checkout revision. Full source includes original runtime patches, package checksums and build scripts.

Latest upstream default-branch commit preceding the attested 2026-10-17 toolchain build window; inferred from upstream Git history, not attested clone HEAD. All retained build scripts, MinGW patches and earlier GCC patches match configuration-origin bytes. The only extra GCC16.2 patches change LoongArch/MIPS compiler backends, with no x86 or runtime source changes. Retained as conservative source/patch superset.

CT_GCC_VERSION in the pinned BtbN toolchain config and embedded DLL compiler identifier; upstream source checksum from crosstool-ng packages/gcc/16.2.0/chksum. Covers statically linked libgcc/libstdc++/libgomp.

CT_MINGW_W64_VERSION in the pinned BtbN toolchain config; release checksum from crosstool-ng packages/mingw-w64/v14.0.0/chksum. The separately retained 10-mingw dependency snapshot captures the later patched headers/runtime used by dependency recipes.

Pinned source tree of the distributed BtbN runtime; toolchain configuration matches the installed toolchain config byte-for-byte. Sources are retained intact alongside readable recipes; no image/compiler binary is part of this payload.

MinGW-Builds source revision immediately preceding the 2025-03-29 release build, inferred from upstream history. GCC14.2 and MinGWv12 patch lists and configuration are independently recorded in the exact Rust-pinned binary distribution build-info.txt. All14 GCC patches and3 MinGW CRT patches named by that original record are retained here.

coverage: GCC14 runtime code linked via prebuilt Rust GNU target, with conservative libgcc/libstdc++/libgomp source superset

provenance.description: Distributed avcodec DLL contains GCC: (x86_64-posix-seh-rev2, Built by MinGW-Builds project)14.2.0. The exact Rust release install-mingw recipe selects this distribution. Its original build-info.txt identifies GCC14.2 source URL and patches; upstream SHA512 independently matches GNU release checksum list.

coverage: conservative complete MinGWv12 CRT/header/winpthreads source superset for the Rust prebuilt runtime

provenance.description: Rust-pinned MinGW distribution build-info.txt records --rt-version=v12 and the MinGW CRT patch list. Retained mingw-w64-download.sh selects official v12.x branch. This snapshot is the last branch commit preceding that build (2024-06-11), resolved from upstream Git history; the binary build-info generator incorrectly repeats the previous package version/URL for CRT, so those repeated fields are not used as source evidence.

external_build_prerequisites: Compatible Linux host/container engine and normal host build tools.
Compiler executables, Rust tools, Windows SDK/UCRT system binaries and OCI images are external build prerequisites, not corresponding source payload.
Rust std/compiler-builtins source and exact rav1e Cargo/vendor inputs are retained by the Windows collector.

completeness.scope: Linked runtime source and its build/patch/configuration evidence. Compiler executables and their host-only builder identity are external prerequisites.
provenance_limits: Floating CT-NG clone HEAD is not attested; config-origin and build-window sources retain byte-identical runtime build scripts and runtime patches, with the two additional non-x86 compiler patches retained as a superset.

MinGW-Builds script revision and official MinGWv12 branch snapshot are resolved using upstream Git history and original binary build date; the original binary build-info independently pins GCC source URL, patch names and configuration.
